jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Build a sustainable future with Plantation Pine Products. As part of the Borg Group, we manage the full forestry lifecycle, from plantation management and harvesting through to supply into Australian manufacturing operations.

We're seeking a hands-on Environmental Manager to lead and strengthen our environmental framework across forestry operations. You'll assess current practices, identify improvement opportunities, implement practical systems, and provide environmental leadership both in the field and at a strategic level.

This role suits an Environmental Scientist who enjoys balancing strategy with execution and delivering real environmental outcomes.

The role

You will take ownership of environmental management across the business, including plantation forestry operations, regulatory compliance, certification requirements and environmental governance.

Key responsibilities

Manage forestry document control, compliance records, operational procedures and spatial data across plantation and timber supply operations.
Lead regulatory, environmental and certification compliance, including permits, licences, PEFC requirements and Codes of Practice.
Develop and maintain environmental and operational management systems, policies and procedures.
Oversee GIS mapping, spatial data and compliance reporting systems.
Coordinate audits, certification activities and field inspections to support operational compliance and continuous improvement.
Build strong relationships with regulators, certification bodies, landowners and key stakeholders.

About you

Essential

Degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Natural Resource Management or similar.
Knowledge of forestry regulations, Codes of Practice, EPBC requirements, and PEFC certification.
Experience developing environmental systems, policies and governance frameworks.
Strong understanding of environmental legislation and compliance requirements.
Ability to work independently and drive initiatives from concept through implementation.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Willingness to spend time onsite and in the field.

Highly regarded

Forestry, plantation, agriculture or natural resource industry experience.
Hands-on experience with GIS systems and spatial data management.
Experience establishing environmental functions in a growing organisation.
Audit, certification or environmental compliance experience.
Knowledge of carbon, biodiversity or sustainability reporting frameworks.

Why join Plantation Pine Products?

Build an environmental function from the ground up.
Influence environmental strategy and governance.
Work across forestry, plantation and operational activities.
Diverse role combining science, compliance and fieldwork.
Join a growing Australian-owned business committed to sustainability.
Be based in the Bathurst/Orange region with regular site engagement.

Ready to make an impact?

If you’re an experienced environmental professional looking for a hands-on role where you can shape environmental systems, compliance and sustainability across forestry operations, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply now to join Plantation Pine Products and help shape the future of our environmental management.

A degree in Environmental Science, Construction Management, Forestry, or a related field. A degree is preferred but not required.
Energy utility experience.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Associate Chemist prepares and analyzes environmental samples using standard analytical techniques according to approved scientific methodology in compliance with Eurofins Environment Testing Quality Assurance programs and standard operating procedures (SOPs). This position can be a physical job that may require standing for long periods, working with organic solvents, laboratory glassware and specialized equipment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Performs routine lab tasks that provide experience and familiarization with methods, practices, and programs. These include:
Preparation of samples using standard techniques
Performing chemical analysis using standard techniques
Evaluation and quantification of data
Recording and reporting data and any unusual test occurrences to the supervisor
Performing routine instrument maintenance

Competency in complex instrumentation instrument specific software (training is provided)
Responsible for keeping personal training documentation (training records, IDOC/DOC) current and accurate
Responsible for timely completion of assigned/scheduled QC samples (MDL, LOD/LOQ, PT)
As required, documents NCMs for projects with quality issues
Understands and utilizes backlog reports to manage personal workload
Works under close supervision using routine and standard methods
Regular attendance and punctuality
Responsible for general housekeeping in work area
Proficient with IDOCs, for assigned methods carried out in the department
Responsible for performing job functions in compliance with Eurofins Environment health and safety and quality assurance standards
Demonstrates and promotes the company vision
Inventories and stocks laboratory supplies
Washes and inventories glassware
Purges analyzed samples
Assists in other areas of laboratory when needed
Additional duties as assigned

Follow and learn appropriate protocols in one or more of the following disciplines. This role will focus on PFAS Analysis and LC/MS.

Organic preparation
Metals preparation and analysis
PFAS sample preparation
HRMS sample preparation
Gas Chromatography
Liquid Chromatography
Mass Spectrometry
Radio Chemistry
Wet Chemistry
High Resolution preparation and analysis
Low Resolution preparation and analysis

This position is 2nd shift, Sun-Thurs, 3pm -1130pm. Training will be M-F 7am-3:30pm.

Qualifications

Basic Minimum Qualifications

BS or BA in Chemistry or related field, Associate Degree, or 2 years of related laboratory experience in lieu of degree.
Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English.
Authorization to work in the United States without restriction or sponsorship

Ideal Candidates Will Have

Previous experience with PFAS and/or LC/MS
Previous experience in a lab or production setting
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
Able to interpret written materials and communicate findings effectively.
Demonstrated ability to identify issues, analyze root causes, and propose practical solutions.
Applies critical thinking to evaluate options and make decisions.
Effective collaboration skills to contribute to team goals and support department productivity goals
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.
Effectively balances multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy.
Comfortable using mathematical formulas and tools to perform calculations and analyze data.
Consistently delivers high-quality work within established timelines and specifications.
Able to work independently, following written or verbal instructions with minimal oversight.
Strong interpersonal skills; able to coordinate tasks and communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

Additional Information

Pay rate: $18-19/hour + 10% shift differential

The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee’s full-time or part-time regular status.

Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!
Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us!
At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
